name: kneeling back rotation stretch
description: Kneeling on all fours and rotating through your trunk mobilises and stretches your mid back. Slow and controlled works best.
instructions: Start on your hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders.
Place one hand behind your head and rotate your elbow up toward the ceiling.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
